feature: A drawing shows what was asked, pose and all (fourth pass)
summary: Ask no longer paints a picture again for a detail nobody asked for: its plan for a pose or a scene keeps only what your words ask for, every retry is held to that same plan, and after the last retry the closest try is the one you get.
setup: Photonz Probe, release Next, no switch changed from its default, with the picture model set up in Settings > Ask. Walk: Scripts/playtest/ask-draws-a-scene-walk.json.

try.do: Open a blank picture, press Ask, type "draw a cat playing a guitar" and send it.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Ask for "draw an angry bird" and time it: about 40 seconds, not about 110.
Ask for "draw a robot watering a plant" and check the robot holds the can and water reaches the plant.
Compare the eleven pose and scene drawings from this pass.

evaluate: Does a plain request with a mood ("an angry bird") now come back in about the time a plain thing takes?
Do the scenes still show the relationship you asked for (paws on the guitar, water on the plant)?
Is a single dark silhouette, like the black cat on the sheet, acceptable for "seen from behind", or should a dark subject always keep inner lines?
